entities.name: Kinesis (input stream)

entities.name: Lambda (first, top)
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'LAMBDA' at top-centre (AWS_Icon_5, 309,68). Receives arrows from the top Kinesis and the top RDS, and points down to SQS. Not inside any container.

entities.name: RDS (top, source/lookup)
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'RDS' at top-right (AWS_Icon_4, 393,68). An arrow points from it to the top Lambda; a curved arrow also enters it from above-left with no drawn source. Not inside any container.

entities.name: SQS queue
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'SQS' in the centre (AWS_Icon_3, 310,139), between the two Lambdas. Not inside any container.

entities.name: Lambda (second, bottom)
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'LAMBDA' at lower-centre (AWS_Icon_2, 310,209). Fed by SQS and fans out to the bottom RDS and bottom Kinesis. Not inside any container.

entities.name: RDS (bottom, destination)
entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'RDS' at bottom-left (AWS_Icon_1, 249,262). Target of an arrow from the bottom Lambda. Not inside any container.

entities.rationale: Icon labelled 'KINESIS' at bottom-right (~370,262). Target of an arrow from the bottom Lambda. Not inside any container.
